evidence: DRIFT 1 (the Fail). The health route is a runtime fact stated in the brief and the harness but missing from every judge-facing file while a criterion consumes it. environment/instructions/integration.md:3 says 'answer GET /api/health promptly'; tests/test.sh:48 and :136 probe 'http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/health'. tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:290 (cw_preview_isolation, weight 1.5 of 54.0) requires 'confirm that the app page itself can load its own health address, as working controls' and later 'try to fetch the app's own health address' from the preview. Neither tests/app_context.md (lines 1-24) nor tests/scored/functional/prompt.md names that path; a grep for 'health' across tests/ finds only judge.toml:290, judge.toml:308 ('a health response') and the two test.sh probes. tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:21 instead instructs 'Do not guess URL paths or API routes', and prompt.md:13 says that if a control cannot be performed 'the criterion fails'. The golden UI never requests the route (0 occurrences of 'api/health' in solution/app/public/assets/index.js), so it cannot be learned from recorded network activity. The owner's scripted golden had to hardcode it: qc/repairs/coldwater-2026-10-02-strict/tests/runtime.cjs:126 fetch('/api/health') and :135 'http://localhost:3000/api/health'. DRIFT 2 (minor, lenient direction). environment/instructions/behaviour.md:11 requires the library refresh 'within about five seconds'; judge.toml:344 allows 'up to ten seconds' and 'within ten seconds', judge.toml:362 'Within ten seconds'. Golden polls every 2 s (solution/app/src/app.tsx:133; built bundle 'setInterval(quiet, 2e3)'). DRIFT 3 (harmless). solution/app/server.js:8 also reads SQLITE_PATH, which no other file mentions; DB_PATH takes precedence so the contract holds. EVERYTHING ELSE RE-DERIVED AND AGREEING. Port 3000: integration.md:3, test.sh:108 and :164 (PORT), all five prompt.md line 1, app_context.md:4, server.js:142. Entry /app/server.js: integration.md:3, test.sh:68 and :97, solve.sh:6. Database: integration.md:9 default /app/app.db and DB_PATH; test.sh:98-101,109,165; server.js:8; solve.sh:10,37. Seed: instruction.md:3, integration.md:7, task.toml:2 artifacts, seed_data.json 'snippets': []; app_context.md:21 does not assume an empty library. Clock: no fixed clock is stated anywhere and no criterion figure depends on one (N-A). Accounts: instruction.md:5 'without signing in', overview.md:3, policy.md:3, app_context.md:10 'None'. Judge: task.toml:31-36 is the frozen block; every judge.toml has only judge = "claude-code" with no model. Shares: scoring.toml equals the template byte for byte (0.6/0.2/0.2, gates 0.0, floor 0.05) and the directory names match. Restart helper: test.sh:193 exports APP_RESTART_HELPER; functional/judge.toml:18 passes "$APP_RESTART_HELPER"; prompt.md:30 and judge.toml:308 name restart_app; only one criterion names it. Budgets nest: gate judges 600+600 < 1500; scored judges 9000+900+900 = 10800 < 11100; 1500+11100 = 12600 < 13200. Counts: task.toml description and provenance quote no criterion count; actual blocks are render 1, constraints 2, functional 38, polish 6, visual 3, matching the '3 gate, 38 Functional and 6 Polish' in raw-evidence-index.json; ids unique. 'six notes' (instruction.md:3) equals the six files in environment/instructions. Literals agree: five-second run budget (behaviour.md:5, judge.toml:263, runtime.ts:141 and :374), two-space nesting (ui.md:15, judge.toml:191,200, custom-editor.js tabWidth: 2), about 390 px (ui.md:17, polish/judge.toml:69), Alt+Click or Ctrl/Cmd+Click (ui.md:9, judge.toml:101,119), .js/.html (overview.md:3, app_context.md:6, server.js:46), visual 'ten-line' draft and desktop size (visual/prompt.md:10-11, visual/judge.toml:24). tests/test.sh, score.py, restart_mcp.py, both Dockerfiles, scoring.toml and .dockerignore are identical to the frozen template; static/runner.html equals public/runner.html. No configured judge run exists, so the effect of drift 1 on a real judge is unmeasured.
counterexample: Conforming app that fails: the golden itself. A judge following functional/prompt.md:21 ('Do not guess URL paths or API routes') has no stated or discoverable health address, cannot perform the working control in judge.toml:290, and under prompt.md:13 must fail cw_preview_isolation (1.5 of 54.0 functional weight, about 1.7 percent of total reward) on a fully isolated preview. Broken app that passes drift 2: a library that refreshes every nine seconds violates behaviour.md:11 ('about five seconds') yet passes cw_live_library_update and cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft, which allow ten.
suggested_fix: Add one line to tests/app_context.md naming the brief's health address (GET /api/health on http://localhost:3000, from the integration note) so the cw_preview_isolation control and the preview fetch use a stated route, or name it inside judge.toml:290. Optionally state in the two live-update criteria that ten seconds is the five-second requirement plus observation margin, mirroring the wording already used at judge.toml:263.
